scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,blue "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.node.json
